summary: Iter 55 – Verifying AI Trader Setup-Backtest improvements (deep diagnostics, more knobs, learning loop). All 54 targeted unit tests pass; new API test file (3 tests) validates public overview, auth guard, and single mean_reversion run with diag/lessons/history persistence – all green. Frontend flow via localStorage admin_token opens Backtester → 'KI Trader · Setups' tab; ai-seed-panel, ai-seed-pending, 3 pending crypto entries with change rows, ai-seed-table with 1 diag row, Strategies tab and close all function; no JS errors caused by these changes.

issues: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' – appears to be caused by Emergent DOM-inspector instrumentation injecting <span> into <option value={d}> in DAY_OPTIONS render (AITraderSeeding.js:196). Noise-only, no functional impact, but pollutes console.

AUTH: /run correctly returns 401 without token; overview stays public.
Minor: transient 503s from preview ingress during long-poll status GETs required retry-on-5xx in test client (added). Consider server-side keepalive/handling if seen in prod.
seed_data_creation: One real mode='single' ai_revise=false run for crypto/mean_reversion/30d executed during test; result appended to last_result & history.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature works end-to-end. Do NOT trigger mode='ai_loop' or ai_revise=true (LLM credits). If preview ingress returns 503 during long polls, retry rather than fail.
